The denominator covers people aged 20-34 with an upper secondary or post-secondary non-tertiary educational attainment of vocational orientation who had successfully completed their highest level of education in the last three years.

title: Flash Eurobarometer 378: The experience of traineeships in the EU
description: Traineeships are very helpful in ensuring smooth education-to-work transitions, but only if they provide a solid learning content and safe working conditions. This survey seeks to provide a picture about the quality of traineeships in the EU. It looks at young people's personal traineeship experiences including the existence of learning objectives, the availability of a mentor, the working conditions, the existence of a written traineeship agreement, the length of the traineeship, as well as eventual pay remuneration and/or compensation.

title: Flash Eurobarometer FL523 : Integration of young people into the labour market with particular focus on traineeships
description:
This Eurobarometer survey shows that traineeships are an important stepping stone for young people into the labour market. 78% of young people surveyed did at least one traineeship, and 19% their first work experience was a traineeship. 68% found a job following a traineeship, with 39% signing a contract with the same employer, according to the data. 
#### Processed data
Processed data files for the Eurobarometer surveys are published in .xlsx format.

title: On the way to 2020: data for vocational education and training policies
description:
European policy-making in vocational education and training (VET) needs to be supported by sound quantitative information. 
Cedefop has selected a set of 32 statistical indicators to quantify key aspects of VET and lifelong learning, based on their policy relevance and importance for achieving the Europe 2020 objectives. The aim is to help describe, monitor and compare countries.
This update incorporates new hard evidence from the European statistical system.

The table lists 31 identified platforms and webpages where relevant training materials, such as videos, webinars, MOOCs, modules, and full courses, can be accessed.

title: Short-term anticipation of skills trends and VET demand (STAS)
description: The Short-term anticipation of skills trends and VET demand data (STAS) produces short-term projections of employment by occupation in the EU up to two years ahead of from the last period of available data. The STAS uses the EU LFS quarterly and annual data on employment by occupation, sector and Member State as well as vacancy data from the European Job Vacancy Statistics. The STAS baseline is then aligned to the forecasted total employment growth released by DG ECFIN in the AMECO database.

title: Special Eurobarometer 369: Attitudes towards vocational education and training
description: Vocational education and training (VET) is an essential tool when it comes to preparing young people for work in the modern economy. This Eurobarometer survey sets out to assess the image that European citizens have of vocational education and training and of its potential impact on society and on the economy. It also looks at the factors that influence young people when they choose between vocational education and training and other forms of education.

title: Special Eurobarometer SP569 : Attractiveness of Vocational Education and Training
description:
The Special Eurobarometer on the attractiveness of Vocational Education and Training (VET) highlights citizens’ positive views on VET as a pathway to well-paid jobs and opportunities – but the overall image of Vocational Education and Training lags behind.

title: Survey on Awareness and Perceptions of Biodiversity and Nature-Based Solutions in Higher Education, TVET, Professional Circles, and Society at Large
description: This dataset was generated through a consortium-wide online survey conducted under Task 1.2 of the eNaBlS project. The survey assessed awareness, perceptions, concerns, and expectations regarding biodiversity loss and Nature-Based Solutions (NBS) among higher education (HE), vocational training (TVET), professional sectors, and the general public across the EU and beyond. Led by the University of Hohenheim (UHOH), the survey was available in all EU languages plus Arabic, Turkish, and Ukrainian.

title: Survey with Higher Education Institutions and TVET Organisations on Nature-Based Solutions and Biodiversity Loss in their Curricula
description: The survey was conducted across the member countries of the ᴇNᴀBʟS consortium. Its purpose was to examine the extent to which the concepts of Nature-Based Solutions (NBS) and the challenges associated with biodiversity loss are integrated into existing curricula. The respondents comprised staff from Higher Education Institutions (HEIs) and Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) organisations. Contact Person: Sri Dhanya AdusumilliEmail: sridhanya.adusumilli@uni-hohenheim.de Disclaimer: Funded by the European Union.

title: Timeline of VET policies in Europe
description:
The Timeline of VET policies in Europe presents more than 1000 national strategies, pieces of legislation, and practical measures from the EU-27, Iceland and Norway on themes related to the European priorities in VET. The dataset makes these qualitative data available for in-depth analyses and comparative research.
The data are collected annually by Cedefop in cooperation with the ReferNet (https://www.cedefop.europa.eu/en/networks/refernet), its European network of expertise in VET.

title: Basis for mobility flows: Vocational mobility (home-to-work travel)
description:

Each flow base associated with a theme provides, for all municipalities (metropolitan France and overseas departments), the number of staff corresponding to the crossings of the place of residence with one of the following location variables: place of work, place of study, previous place of residence.

description:
Voluntary intake points (VAPs) allow the direct deposit of certain types of waste by metropolitan users. It is an essential alternative to door-to-door collection.
From January 2023, new voluntary contribution points dedicated to the flow of glass were installed in 26 municipalities and three districts of Lille’s European Metropolis. This massive deployment, dedicated to the collection of glass, aims to be deployed in all the municipalities of the metropolis before the end of 2025.
This initiative is part of a national goal of valorizing glass packaging.

In future, the data will be available under the record name ‘#GeoKarriere4U#’.
The survey of Hamburg's training companies in surveying technology visualizes Hamburg's surveying and engineering offices, which offer training in the field of surveying technology. Erleichtert wird die Suche nach einem geeigneten Ausbildungsplatz im geodätischen Tätigkeitsfeld durch die Angabe von Kontaktdaten. 
Zusätzlich kann man sich einen Eindruck verschaffen, ob in diesem Ausbildungsbetrieb auch ein Praktikum möglich ist.

title: Blended learning analyst in higher education, 2019
publisher: UNIVERZA V LJUBLJANI, FAKULTETA ZA DRUŽBENE VEDE
description:
Blended learning, which represents the intertwining of traditional teaching in a lecture room with implementation in an online environment, is becoming increasingly present in higher education. 
 Learning management systems in which e-learning takes place store each student's interaction with the system in log files. 
 At the same time, various databases of educational data are kept about the student in electronic form, and surveys are also increasingly implemented in the online environment.

title: Impact of organisational learning and innovation on performance
publisher: UNIVERZA V LJUBLJANI, FAKULTETA ZA DRUŽBENE VEDE
description: The purpose of the research was to present and test a model for improving innovation based on the influence of the culture of organizational learning. title: Verification of instruments to identify individual differences in self-regulation of learning, 2019
publisher: UNIVERZA V LJUBLJANI, FAKULTETA ZA DRUŽBENE VEDE
description:
The purpose of the research was to develop tools to identify differences between students in their knowledge of the strategies they use in individual learning and their actual use.
 The aim of the pilot research was to organise and/or develop instruments to measure the individual characteristics of learners in self-regulation of learning. Cognitive instruments were checked. 
 Metacognitive and emotional-motivation processes that make up self-regulation. Slovenian students who attended the 9th grade of primary school in the 2018/2019 school year participated in the survey.

title: Apprentices of the regular school in the canton of Zurich by citizenship at school community level from 2000
description:
Students at regular public schools in the canton of Zurich who are taught according to cantonal curricula. Normal school refers to schooling during compulsory schooling. Compulsory schooling includes kindergarten, six years of primary school and three years of secondary school. Not included are middle school learners, students in home/special schools, and students in private schools. The school location principle applies, and students who attend a school within the canton of Zurich are counted.
The data are collected annually for the reference date 15.9.

title: Apprentice levy returns
description:
Calderdale Council remains committed to creating opportunities through apprenticeships and workforce development.
Between 1 April 2017 and 31 March 2021, public sector organisations in England with 250 or more employees were required to work towards the Government's Public sector apprenticeship target. This target aimed for new apprenticeship starts to average at least 2.3% of the workforce during that period.
As part of this requirement, organisations were required to publish apprenticeship workforce data and submit returns to the Department for Education.

title: Apprenticeships Vacancies in England
description:
Data on the number of vacancies posted and applications made through the Apprenticeship vacancy online system.
Apprenticeship vacancies is the official job site for Apprenticeships in England and is managed by the National Apprenticeship Service. The Apprenticeship vacancy online system allows employers to advertise vacancies which can be searched by candidates by geography, occupation, job role and keywords.
Data presented here refers only to applications reported through the online system and are presented to show its performance.

title: Cambridgeshire County Council Apprenticeship Data
description:
The government introduced a number of changes in April 2017 to encourage employers to offer more apprenticeship opportunities to both their current employees and to new staff joining their organisations. One of the changes introduced requires public sector organisations who employ more than 250 staff to have a target to achieve an average 2.3% of their workforce on apprenticeship programmes.
Each year (until 2021) the council is required to tell the government how they are progressing against their target and to make this information available to the public.
